messages.subject: Meridian/Harcourt – proposed liability compromise
messages.plaintextBody:
Henry, Helena,

Harcourt pushed for unlimited liability on data breach. My recommendation, which I think they'll accept:

- General liability cap: 150% of the fees paid in the prior 12 months.
- A separate data-protection super-cap of 300% of the annual fee, i.e. £2.52m.
- Payment at 45 days; renewal notice stays 90 days.

This caps your worst-case data-breach exposure at £2.52m. Are you comfortable for us to put this to Marlowe Greaves?

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
